source_summary: Vertical monochrome Chinese winter landscape with towering cliff mountains, misty valleys, small village roofs, water channels, a stilted pavilion, dense pines and snow-laden foreground rocks. The red seal and surrounding paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: towering_central_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant upper central mountain mass: steep rounded cliffs rising from mid-image to the top, with layered ink washes, dark vertical clefts, arched rock forms, sparse pine clusters along ridges, and mist-softened lower edges.
must_preserve: thin contour lines defining rounded cliff edges
dark vertical wash channels and shaded crevices
small clustered pine-needle strokes on ridge tops
arched central rock opening shape
soft fading wash where the cliffs descend into mist

motifs.name: right_receding_mountain_ridges
motifs.description: Isolate the pale receding mountain ridges on the upper right, including overlapping rounded silhouettes behind the main cliff and the lightly brushed atmospheric depth.
must_preserve: faint contour outlines of successive ridges
pale ink wash transitions
soft atmospheric separation between ridge layers
subtle darker vertical cliff accents near the lower edges

motifs.name: left_misty_village_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the small distant village and tree grove in the left middle distance: tiny roof triangles among vertical winter trees, set against a low mist band and pale hills.
must_preserve: tiny pitched roof geometry
fine vertical tree trunks and needle-like strokes
low pale hill silhouette behind the village
misty horizontal wash separating village from water

motifs.name: left_water_bridge_and_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the left-side watercourse with quiet layered water shapes, small rocks, snowy banks, and the simple narrow bridge at the lower-left crossing.
must_preserve: thin horizontal water-edge lines
rounded snow-covered rock forms
dark ink accents under rocks and banks
simple bridge planks and short vertical supports
irregular shoreline curves

motifs.name: stilted_waterside_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion on stilts near the lower center-left, including its snow-covered roof, open wall framework, platform, and reflections or dark supports beneath.
must_preserve: flat snow-laden roof silhouette
straight architectural linework
open railing and wall divisions
thin vertical stilts
dark shaded underside and platform edge

motifs.name: central_snow_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense central foreground pine grove: tall trunks and broad twisting branches loaded with snow, overlapping foliage needles, and darker ink-textured bark.
must_preserve: twisting branch linework
clusters of fine pine needles
snow highlights along branch tops
dark bark texture on tall trunks
layered overlapping tree depth

motifs.name: right_snowy_bare_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side grove of leafless winter trees and shrubs on snowy slopes, with many pale branching lines and a few darker trunks along the edge of the composition.
must_preserve: delicate bare branch networks
snow-coated branch contours
thin upright trunks
pale wash of surrounding snow bank
dark stippled accents at branch joints

motifs.name: foreground_snow_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground snow-covered rock formations across the bottom, including rounded boulders, sloping ledges, dark undercuts, and the shallow stream edge at the very bottom.
must_preserve: rounded snow-cap silhouettes
dark ink wash under rock ledges
cracked contour lines on stone faces
small scattered pebble shapes
horizontal shallow-water strokes along the bottom edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
